Subject: Charity stream Sat Nov 21 - Linden Community Pantry ($600 goal)

@everyone once - that's the only ping, promise. last year i posted this the thursday before and half the server didn't even know it was happening, so we're doing it early. pin this.

SATURDAY NOVEMBER 21, 10AM - 10PM
Linden Community Pantry charity stream
Goal: $600. Last year we raised $212 with the announcement up way too late. Rook is matching the first $100, so the first $100 counts double.

Donate: lindenpantry.example/mrkz
Money goes straight to the pantry, nothing taken off, and through their wholesale partner every $1 gets them about 4 pounds of food. They're serving around 340 families a week and the shelves are the lowest they've been before Thanksgiving.

Incentives:
$100 - i play a full round with the controller upside down
$250 - chat picks my hair dye color and i do it ON STREAM
$400 - one hour of only chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600 - i vlog a grocery pickup the pantry arranges

Schedule: first half is community lobbies, drop the code any time you want in. second half chat votes the game every 2 hours. and larry, no repeat maps, i promise.

Can't donate? You can still help. The pantry takes canned and boxed food in the blue bin by their side door on Saturdays 9 to 1. Or just show up, keep chat alive, share the link with someone who'd give.

On the "charity streams are cringe" thing - it's a food pantry in columbus and every dollar is about 4 pounds of food, so that word is doing a lot of heavy lifting. it's not a bit, it's a stream that does something useful. if you can't give, that's genuinely fine, nobody's gonna guilt you. even $3 helps.
